Data.Recommendedapproach: Escalate HF-2006 immediately to the application/on-call specialist team and page whoever owns Concur/vendor SaaS availability. Approve the draft as-is unless you want to add an internal incident bridge or phone number not listed in SupportKB; the KB only provides Service Desk extension 4357 and says High severity is triaged within 30 minutes during staffed hours, but it is silent on Concur-specific SLAs. Verify whether other finance users can reproduce the 502 and capture the affected user count, browser/error screenshot, and any Concur status/vendor incident information.
Data.Subject: Concur down for all of finance, month-end close TODAY
Data.Body: The entire finance team gets a 502 error opening Concur since 8am. Month-end close is due today at 6pm and nothing can be approved. This is blocking the close, please treat as critical.
Data.Rationale: This is a Critical Software incident because the entire finance team is blocked, approvals are stopped, and a same-day 6pm month-end close cutoff is at risk. SupportKB confirms Concur is the expense-report portal and provides Service Desk contact details, but it does not provide a Concur 502 outage runbook or vendor escalation steps. Confidence is moderate because the outage handling recommendation is based on severity criteria rather than a Concur-specific KB article.
Data.Draftreply:
Hi Carla,

We’re treating this as an urgent incident and escalating it immediately to the on-call specialist team. I understand the entire finance team is getting a 502 error in Concur and that this is blocking approvals needed for today’s 6pm month-end close.

To help the responders move quickly, please reply with the number of users affected and the best direct phone number for a finance contact who can test with IT.

Concur expense reports are handled through the Concur portal at expenses.homefixsupply.com. If you need to reach the Service Desk while this is being escalated, you can call extension 4357 (HELP), staffed 06:00–20:00 local time, Monday to Saturday.

We’ll keep ownership of this ticket while the specialist team investigates.

Best regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
